g.inkscape:label: 1 - Guides (hide before export)
g.text: PaperGame sprite sheet template (everything is 2x the in-game size)
1. Draw on the layer "3 - YOUR ART" (the other two layers are locked).
2. Keep each drawing INSIDE its red dashed box. Anything outside the box gets cut off.
3. Sprites that turn in the game (players, worms, shots, weapons) must face RIGHT.
4. Leave the background transparent. Don't move or resize the boxes.
5. To export: hide layers 1 and 2, then File > Export > Page, PNG, 96 dpi (1 px = 1 px). Send me the PNG (or this SVG).
turn to face the aim: draw them FACING RIGHT. Bigger box than the old square (32x32): the hitbox stays 26x26 in the middle
one look per armor, used by both players (P2 also gets its orange ring). FACING RIGHT
drawn as they are (they do not turn)
segments turn to face where they move: FACING RIGHT (head points right)
wormling + hog turn to face where they move (FACING RIGHT); the target does not turn
shots turn to face where they fly: FACING RIGHT
just the weapon, pointing RIGHT. RED DOT = the player's center: the weapon is placed and turned around it. Charge rings, ammo pips and swing arcs are drawn by the game
tiles are 64x64 in game (128 here). Obstacles get picked at random from the 3 versions
the whole room (960x640 in game): floor + walls, with ALL 4 door gaps open. Closed doors / wall patches above go on top of the gaps
